lessons.title: Nifty 50, Sensex prediction today: Check how Indian stock market is expected to trade on 27 May
lessons.quote: The lesson is rarely in the noise; it is in what the market chose to reprice.
lessons.lesson: Use yesterday's market news as a question, not an instruction. Ask what changed, whether it is temporary, and whether the price has already reacted before you act.
